about.headline: Building the web,
paragraphs: Fueled by a passion for technology and a knack for problem-solving, I'm a web developer with a drive to craft intuitive and impactful web experiences.

My journey began in the dynamic world of retail, where I honed my leadership and customer-centric skills as a Branch Manager. While exceeding sales targets and building a thriving team, I discovered a passion for web development, which led me to a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, graduating in 2021 with a comprehensive understanding of web principles.
Since then I've delivered production apps end to end, from SaaS platforms to e-commerce, for agencies, trading companies and my own clients through EZdev Solutions.

about.title: A studio that runs what it builds
body: Anthony Kruger founded EZdev after moving from retail branch management into software, graduating with a BSc in IT in 2021.

Today EZdev runs two products of its own, Votera and Chilli Collective, and builds for clients. Operating our own platforms means we feel every slow page and failed payment ourselves, and that is the standard we bring to client work.
